rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=2.5, img_sy=2.5, proj_sx=0.5, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-14, ONE-KNOB change vs the iter-12 CHAMPION base (SSIM 0.974822, PSNR 38.63 dB; proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=0.0005, proj_sx=1.0 default, proj_sy=2.0 default, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5, n_iter=300). KNOB: projection-domain BF SPATIAL sigma proj_sx 1.0 -> 0.5 (TIGHTEN the angular spatial extent of the sinogram BF), ISOLATED. This is the LAST genuinely-untried single-knob axis on this run: the PROJECTION-domain SPATIAL sigmas (proj_sx/proj_sy) were NEVER tuned in isolation -- iter-2 swapped proj_sx+proj_sy+proj_sr ALL AT ONCE off the WRONG loose base (img_sr=0.02, img_n_bf=1; confounded, HURT 0.9680, reverted). At the established tight-RANGE peak regime (proj_sr=0.0005, img all tuned) the proj-spatial sigma has never been isolated. EVERYTHING else identical to iter-12 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5, seed=42; proj_sy/img_kernel/proj_kernel at Wagner-abdomen defaults). TRAJECTORY: iter-4 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.9732 PEAK; iter-8 (proj_sr 0.02->0.0005 ISOLATED) 0.9747 NEW PEAK +0.0015; iter-9 (proj_sr->0.0001) FLAT; iter-10 (proj_n_bf 1->2) FLAT; iter-11 (img_sx 1.5->0.5 TIGHTEN) FLAT; iter-12 (img_sx/img_sy 1.5->2.5 WIDEN) 0.974822 CHAMPION (+0.0001); iter-13 (img_sx/img_sy 2.5->3.5) 0.974814 FLAT -- image-spatial-sigma axis CONFIRMED saturated (0.5/1.5/2.5/3.5 all ~0.9748). FAILURE MODE at 0.9748: the 12-param bilateral is at its breast FBP-bounded representational ceiling; hr=0, PSNR ~38.63 pinned ~1 dB under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline. EXHAUSTED axes: img_n_bf, img_kernel (7->9 flat), img_sr (tight peak), proj_sr (0.0005 peak, 0.0001 flat), proj_n_bf (2 flat), img_sx/img_sy (full sweep flat), n_iter, pretrain, seed. The ONLY genuinely-untried single-knob axis remaining is the projection-domain SPATIAL sigma (proj_sx/proj_sy), never isolated at the peak base. WHY proj_sx TIGHTEN NOW: img_sr's TIGHT direction broke the image-range ceiling (iter-3) and proj_sr's TIGHT direction broke the proj-range ceiling (iter-8) -- TIGHTENING range sigmas is the proven winning direction on breast's real-mu substrate. By symmetry, at tight proj_sr=0.0005 (edge-preserving in sinogram intensity) the Wagner-abdomen proj_sx=1.0 angular spatial extent may over-average across adjacent sparse-view rays; tightening proj_sx 1.0->0.5 restricts sinogram averaging to the nearest same-ray samples BEFORE FBP, the spatial-extent counterpart of the range-tightening that already broke two ceilings. This isolates proj_sx ONLY (proj_sy stays at 2.0 default, unlike confounded iter-2). HYPOTHESIS: tightening the projection-domain BF angular spatial sigma proj_sx 1.0->0.5 at tight proj_sr cleans the sinogram with a tighter same-ray spatial support before FBP, lifting SSIM above the 0.974822 champion. If FLAT (within +-0.0005 of 0.9748) the projection-SPATIAL axis is ALSO exhausted, CONFIRMING the ~0.9748 12-param breast bilateral structural ceiling holds across RANGE (img_sr/proj_sr), DEPTH (img_n_bf/proj_n_bf), KERNEL (img_kernel), OPTIMIZATION (n_iter) and the FULL SPATIAL-sigma family in BOTH domains -- the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view breast FBP (mirroring dd-bf-supervised 0.9502 on Mayo). WALL: BF spatial cost is independent of sigma VALUE (same proj_kernel=5 window, same unfold); step budget IDENTICAL to iter-12 (n_iter=300, val_n=16; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-12 ran 497 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged. ONE knob changed: proj_sx 1.0->0.5 (isolated).
